text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: —In other words, it finally dawned on me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
If you've never earned a living by your 
own sweat, you can't claim you've found 
true freedom.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
That makes you just like a little bush 
warbler that can't even finish its 
song...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out to my part-time job now, 
and I'm saying you're tagging along with 
me!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yup, a thrilling fixed-term employment 
contract. Complete with "Welcooome!" and 
"Thank ya kindlyyy!"

According to Tracen Academy regulations, 
part-time jobs are permitted if you get 
approval, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
For some reason, I can't get permission at 
all. I'm totally raring to go, so isn't 
that weird?

...Indeed, one would hesitate to release 
this to the public.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't look all satisfied! Are you 
seriously okay with your trainee being 
totally speechless?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, *I'm* not fine with it!! If it's 
come to this—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
First, let's practice for the part-time 
job!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I found us a practice spot, babyyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Are you ready? You good? Then let's start 
the thinking time!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
1. Sparkling☆ Manual labor with the dorm 
head! 2. Heart-pounding☆ Cooking yakisoba 
for hungry bellies! Which will it be?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Tsk, tsk, tsk... By the way, if you run 
out of time, you get the 'Snap-Crack☆Fold 
Trainer in Half'!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! So that's why you two came to 
help out. How admirable!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It's the Ritto Dorm's turn for pool 
cleaning duty, and we were just looking 
for an extra pair of hands. Much 
appreciated!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to Maid Golshi, Master! Even the 
most stubborn water stains will be gone in 
a flash, I assure you~!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, how dependable. ...Just what is 
with that persona, though...?

Peculiar persona aside, Gold Ship cleaned 
the pool surprisingly efficiently.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: UWOOOOOORYARYARYARYARYARYAAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Ritto Dorm Residents
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? What magnificent brushwork...! It's 
as if it were an extension of her limbs... 
no, it's as if she herself has become one 
with the deck brush!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Even you guys? What's with that 
persona...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Mission Complete, cleaning 
finished!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
No, that was magnificent, Golshi...! 
Thanks to you, we finished much faster 
than I expected!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I can't give you money, but as someone 
who contributed so much, I'd love to give 
you some kind of reward."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Seriously!? Did you just say you'd give me 
anything!? You totally said it, right!?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I never said that, though?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fufufuun, I hear ya, I hear ya. Well 
then~...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've made up my mind! I wanna freeze this 
whole pool and turn it into shaved ice to 
eaaaaat~~!!!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... That's a fun idea, but 
hygiene-wise, that's a bit...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight, Tachyoooon!! Gimme a potion 
that freezes tons of water in an instant, 
pleaaaseee!!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what an appropriate choice of 
opponent...! Wait, Golshi! Hold onnnn!!

"...Together with Fuji Kiseki, I chased 
Gold Ship all over the place until we were 
completely exhausted as she scrambled away 
wielding a deck brush."

And before I knew it, Gold Ship had 
gathered all the yakisoba ingredients and 
set up the teppanyaki grill—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...I heard that one could eat delicious 
yakisoba here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! Party of one... Wait, make that 
two, right?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Oho~, that's a mighty fine griddle you've 
got there. Heat power looks top-notch too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Make a yakisoba so good it'll make even 
this gutsy Naniwa Umamusume sing its 
praises... I'm countin' on ya, Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, but I don't really have anything 
I can say back to that.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I'll let this griddle do all the 
talking... I decided that five minutes 
ago!!

Gold Ship went about making yakisoba with 
surprisingly deft skill...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Deryaaaaaaaaaaahーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wh... Look at how they handle those 
spatulas! The noodles are dancing 
gracefully in midair... evaporating the 
excess moisture and keeping them from 
getting soggy!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...We have a crisis, Tama. For the first 
time in my life, I think... I'm about to 
drown in my own drool...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What kind of situation even is this?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...What an incredible flavor! I can't 
even say much... No words can match how 
eloquently this dish speaks!"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Seconds, please...!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Guess so. That's pretty much all I 
can say.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis Tamamo! In that case, I'll go 
ahead and...!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you've mastered it all! The sign of 
Naniwa-spirited Umamusume Yakisoba... You 
carry it on your shoulders now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Big sis...!! Thank you so muchhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Um... seconds, please...

Gold Ship's yakisoba was so delicious it 
made all the little details not matter 
anymore.
